description: Extension of the Process class that adds a method to run the process and read data from a specified pipe to prevent blocking.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: An extension adding functionality to the built-in Process class to facilitate running a process and reading its output without blocking.

methods.name: runAndReadToEnd(from:)
methods.description: Runs the process, reads all data from the specified pipe to avoid blocking, and waits for the process to exit.
